operative_sections_inspected.quote: Table 1 - Projected 2026 Shipment Volume (units) - provided by management
Table 2 - Historical Annual Rate Increases 2020-2025 and 2026 Estimate
Jan 24, 2021 Priority Mail ~3.5% (USPS). A further Aug 29, 2021 change is listed by ShipperHQ but no Priority Mail % was found, so excluded
Method: simple arithmetic mean of the six annual increases per carrier; each carrier's own average is applied to that carrier's current rates as the 2026 estimate (cell B10 / C10 / D10).
Table 3 - Current Published Flat Rate Prices per Package (USD, standard speed, business/commercial rates, 48 contiguous states)
USPS: Notice 123, effective Oct 4, 2026.
USPS offers no Extra Large flat rate box, so USPS is excluded from that size.
FedEx: One Rate pricing effective Sep 11, 2026.
verify against the PDF before final use.
* UPS XS is assumed equivalent to a Pak (UPS has no pak-branded Simple Rate);
All are each carrier's standard (non-expedited) option for flat rate.
Table 4 - Estimated 2026 Cost per Package and Total Annual Cost by Carrier
Unit price rounded to the cent before multiplying by volume.
USPS total on row 10 omits Extra Large (not offered), so it is not comparable to FedEx/UPS totals.
Table 5 - Recommended Carrier by Package Size for 2026
Pak: UPS (Simple Rate XS, Ground). Small Box: USPS (Small Flat Rate Box, Commercial). Medium, Large and Extra Large: UPS (Simple Rate M / L / XL, Ground).
Extra Large: only FedEx and UPS offer a flat rate; USPS is excluded from that size.
re-check the Pak (and Small Box) once USPS pricing reverts, and confirm the UPS XS-for-Pak equivalence.
FedEx is not the lowest in any size; it is never the recommended carrier under standard (Express Saver) service.
Sources (all retrieved 2026-11-06) and Assumptions
the analysis rests only on the assignment text and public web research.
so the figures likely overstate true 2026 cost and could be double counting.
Each carrier's own average increase is used for that carrier (UPS and FedEx 5.73%, USPS Priority Mail ~5.05%).
The company's actual negotiated/account discounts, if any, were not provided and are not modeled.
No add-ons (signature, Saturday delivery, insurance, pickup) are included.
Alaska/Hawaii shipments are out of scope.
Ship-from Nevada zone effects are not material for flat rates, except FedEx Standard Overnight (not used).

task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook supplies all requested table types and shipment volumes, but the specified numerical totals fail materially. It knowingly applies another increase to late-2026 rates, commits to UPS XS as a Pak equivalent without shipment dimensions, and excludes Alaska/Hawaii despite the USA-wide request. Its notes disclose these issues without resolving operational direction. Formula implications were assessed from supplied inputs; rendering, engine recalculation, and human acceptance remain unverified.
